broadcasts.message: normalize.js final: NFKC, lowercase, collapse whitespace to single space, trim. Faithful to input, no other transformations. All modules align with spec. Ready for delivery.

tokenizer.js final: calls injected normalize(text), extracts ASCII alphanumeric runs with interior apostrophes, returns array in order. No stopwords, no negation filtering. Faithful and stable. All modules ready.

Final pipeline.js delivered. Faithful processing: preserves token order, counts all tokens, handles 'constructor' via null-prototype frequencies, unique in first-seen order. No shadowing of tokenize. Ready for production.
